items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: Dave Payton, yeah. And we played all the toughest shows and played band numbers too.

ctx.x: Dave Payton, yeah. And we played all the toughest shows and played band numbers too. Every week we had to play a band number. And they featured me several times on the banjo. I played the world's waiting for sunrise, you know, Melvin' Chords and whipped it up. And several other numbers. Hebe-jeebies I think was another one we used to play there.
Wasn't Bud Scott also there? Did you play by?
